name: Visual Novel Sisters
source:
Once upon a time, two sisters lived in the same area. The eldest was a beautiful and kind girl, and the youngest was very angry. Two sisters decided to go to the mountains to collect acorns. However, everything turned out to be far from simple...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734890/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
从前，有两姐妹住在同一个地区。老大是个美丽善良的女孩，老三却很生气。两姐妹决定去山上采橡子。然而，一切却远没有那么简单……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734890/]Steam[/url]]
